lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.text: Oh! Hey, Kiko! Didn't see you there.

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.text: Sorry, I'm counting steps in my head.

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.text: Indayog has a performance coming up for the school fair.

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.text: A real dancer can rehearse anywhere!

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.text: If I can nail the routine without bumping into anyone, I can do it on any stage.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: That's one way to train, I guess.

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.text: The stage crew keeps moving our schedule around.

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.text: So I just practice wherever I happen to be.
